items.title: Brazil's central bank orders exchanges to delay large crypto transfers abroad
items.summary: The rule applies to transfers above $10,000 and smaller transactions flagged as risky by exchanges.

items.title: New XRP Ledger amendments target $530 million in tokenized Wall Street assets
items.summary: A new XRPL amendment proposal would let institutions encrypt token balances and transfer amounts while still giving issuers, auditors and regulators selective access.

items.title: Bitcoin holders risk losing real BTC if they sell coins from BIP-110 fork, says developer
items.summary: If a minority chain appears this weekend, buyers could replay signed fork-coin sales on bitcoin itself, making doing nothing the safest move until the chains can be separated.

items.title: BitMEX sale collapsed as buyers balked at founder ownership and shrinking business
items.summary: Potential buyers, including Exodus, passed on BitMEX amid concerns over founder ownership and its shrinking business, according to a source familiar.

items.title: How a five-second trick let traders drain millions from Polymarket
items.summary: After months of public warnings from onchain analysts, the prediction market is moving to time-weighted prices to make artificial price pushes too costly.

items.title: Bitcoin’s volatility has nearly disappeared. The risk hasn’t.
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Aug. 7, 2026

items.title: Bitcoin price tags $65.3K August high as low US jobs numbers cool Fed rate bets
items.summary: Bitcoin hit month-to-date highs above $65,000 as risk-assets gained on low US nonfarm payrolls data.

items.title: Controversial Bitcoin fork BIP-110 mines two blocks, then stops
items.summary: The breakaway chain inherited bitcoin’s mining difficulty with only a tiny share of hashpower, leaving blocks hours apart while both chains still accept the same transactions.

items.title: BTCPay restricts remote Lightning access after attackers steal funds
items.summary: Foundation and Citadel21 reported drained Lightning nodes, but the total amount stolen and number of affected operators remain unknown.

items.title: Bitcoin hits block 961,632 as the controversial BIP-110 soft fork attempt begins
items.summary: The proposal has scant support from bitcoin miners and influential commentators have also voiced their opposition.

items.title: Hardware wallet sales in Russia more than double as new crypto rules near
items.summary: Wildberries’ average price for hardware wallets fell 13% to 7,900 rubles, and M.Video broadened its range of products, though neither retailer identified the driving force behind the renewed demand.

items.title: Trillions in institutional money to flow into bitcoin, says Bitwise's Matt Hougan
items.summary: The digital asset manager's CIO says large capital pools control up to $200 trillion globally, and just a 1% shift toward bitcoin could unlock massive long-term growth.

items.title: Why trillion-dollar asset manager T. Rowe Price put memecoins in its crypto ETF
items.summary: The $1.9 trillion asset manager says excluding established memecoins on principle would undermine its active approach to crypto investing.

items.title: U.S. Senate opens first stage of crypto Clarity Act voting to give bill a chance next month
items.summary: The majority leader opened the multi-stage process the Senate follows when trying to get a bill over its 60-vote hurdle, so it's still got a shot in September.

items.title: Another Bitcoin infrastructure exploit hits, this time draining Lightning payment servers
items.summary: BTCPay told users running LND to update immediately or take servers offline after attackers stole credentials that can control Lightning wallets and move funds.

items.title: Bitcoin’s BIP-110 enters mandatory signaling with miner support below 3%
items.summary: The deployment milestone tests whether enforcing nodes can sustain the change amid limited miner signaling and discussion of a hard-fork fallback.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: US spot Bitcoin ETFs post best week since April with $1B inflows
items.summary: The spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds registered their third-strongest showing since October as institutional demand showed signs of renewed momentum.

items.title: US Senate to vote on advancing CLARITY Act in September after Thune files cloture
items.summary: The procedural move puts crypto market structure legislation back on track as lawmakers continue negotiations over ethics and stablecoin provisions.
